# Brief: Authentication Feature

## Problem Statement

Users need a secure authentication mechanism.
This brief informs Epic 1 and FR101.

## Proposed Solution

Use OAuth2 with Google as the primary provider.
Capability F1 covers this area.

## Success Metrics

- P95 login latency < 500ms (see NFR56)
- Zero auth bypasses
